scope: Local display and optional per-device interaction feedback. No production order writes or actual message sending.
limitations: Mobile viewport Chromium/WebKit tests are not real iPhone device tests.
Native AudioContext/oscillator calls were observed, not physical sound loudness or haptic output.
Clipboard/share payloads captured locally; actual system share sheet was not opened.
No new Firebase emulator run: cloud code and rules unchanged; prior release emulator evidence is not counted in this release.
